correctness.rationale: The proof establishes the necessary-and-sufficient capacity criterion \(a-s\le\binom{t}{2}\), \(b-t\le\binom{s}{2}\), uses upward closure to reduce minimality to one-vertex deletions, proves a size \(b+1\) construction and a deletion-based upper bound for all \(2\le a\le b\), and treats \(K_2\) and stars separately. The maximum-set classification follows by substituting \(|S|=b+1\) and exhausting the omitted count. An explicit path-slot matching verifier checked all subsets of 35 complete bipartite types with \(a\le7\), \(b\le8\), matching every claimed value, pattern, and count.

originality.rationale: Best-of-knowledge searches of the 2021 defining strong-upper paper, exact and notation-variant complete-bipartite queries, ordinary strong-geodetic complete-bipartite papers, later strong-geodetic variants, the current ledger, and repeated semantic repository queries found no equivalent or stronger \(\operatorname{sg}^{+}(K_{a,b})\) formula or maximum-set classification. Located complete-bipartite prior work concerns the minimum parameter \(\operatorname{sg}\), not the upper parameter.

value.rationale: The result gives a closed form for an NP-complete-in-general parameter on a canonical family, then classifies and counts all maximum minimal solutions. The exact geodesic-slot capacity criterion is structural rather than a list of small values and provides a reusable reduction for related questions.
